name: NHGRI educational pages (Talking Glossary, 1000 Genomes Project page)

version.value: Glossary entries updated 2026-10-24; 1000 Genomes page archived, last updated 2017-10-04

scope: Definitions and narration for GWAS, risk, genomic variation, genome and polygenic risk score; archived project description and tutorial slides for the 1000 Genomes Project.

licence.name: NHGRI website content is in the public domain unless otherwise indicated (NHGRI Copyright Policy); material with a credit line is third-party copyrighted and carries its owner's terms
licence.redistribution: Free to use and distribute; NHGRI requests the acknowledgement 'Courtesy: National Human Genome Research Institute' with a link back to genome.gov

update_frequency: Static for the archived page; glossary updated periodically.
coverage_limitations: Background and terminology only; no variant-level data

reuse_decision.rationale: Already collected, verified and preserved under scrape/. No further acquisition.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Not biological evidence: educational definitions and narration, and an archived project description.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Not applicable; educational material with no variant-level data.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: None: educational pages carry no phenotype data.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A concept not covered is not defined here; the pages carry no data from which absence could be inferred.
